{{Quote|Muchi! Muchi!|The captured Falleen clarifies the identity of Muchi, pointing at the rancor|<ref name="Rampage" />}}
A '''Falleen male''' was captured by a group of [[Zygerrian]] [[Enslaver|slave traders]] in [[19 BBY]]. He, along with a [[human]] and a [[Gender|female]] [[Falleen]] [[Unidentified Falleen child|child]] were kept by the slavers in the ruins of [[Old Ord Mantell City]] on the planet of [[Ord Mantell]], overseen by the Zygerrian leader, [[Raney]].<ref name="Rampage" />

In 19 BBY,<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of [[The Bad Batch Season 1|''The Bad Batch'' Season 1]] in [[19 BBY]].</ref> a [[Clone Force 99|renegade clone squad]] took a [[bounty]] job to retrieve a child named [[Muchi]] from the slaver's base, and upon arriving at the ruins, assumed the target to be the Falleen girl as she was the only visible child. The clones successfully distracted the Zygerrians by releasing a caged [[rancor]], allowing them to free the Falleen prisoners. However, when one squad member, [[Omega]], addressed the girl as Muchi, the Falleen prisoner communicated that it was not her who was Muchi, but the rancor. Regardless, the clones freed and safely escorted the Falleen to a pair of [[speeder bike]]s at the south entrance of the city. There, the Falleen escaped the city with the child and thanks his rescuers.<ref name="Rampage" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Falleen prisoner appeared in "[[Rampage (episode)|Rampage]],"<ref name="Rampage" /> the fifth episode of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 28]], [[2021]]. He was portrayed by [[Liam O'Brien]].
